sloka: नित्यम् अस्थिर चित्ता हि कपयो हरि पुंगव ।न आज्ञाप्यम् विषहिष्यन्ति पुत्र दारान् विना त्वया ॥४-५४-९॥
transliteration: nityam asthira cittā hi kapayo hari puṁgava ।na ājñāpyam viṣahiṣyanti putra dārān vinā tvayā ॥4-54-9॥

translations.english: 'O leader among monkeys Vanaras are always fickleminded. Being away from their sons and wives they will not always carry out your command and stay here forever.
